Implement an AArch64 CPU with JIT using an overnight agent herd
An author ran an overnight herd of agents to implement an AArch64 CPU with JIT for the kwemu emulator, since lots of software doesn't build for RISC-V.
·
Nov 18, 2026
Done with a
custom-built or unnamed agent
What they did
Pooya Parsa had already built a RISC-V CPU for the kwemu emulator. He found that much software doesn't build for RISC-V, so he ran a herd of agents overnight to write an AArch64 CPU with a JIT for it. The post doesn't describe the setup, the tooling or where he stepped in.
How it went
The post says the AArch64 CPU with JIT was implemented. He expects Fx, OpenCode and Claude Code to run in the browser soon. It gives no test results, timings or numbers.
Worth knowing
The post is a short announcement. It gives no cost, agent count or prompts, so check his other posts or the kwemu repo for the actual method.
